# Independent literal-byte terminal reference; only run in the guarded guest.
import os
import termios

if os.geteuid() != 2000 or os.getcwd() != '/tmp/parity-case' or os.environ.get('HOME') != '/tmp/parity-home':
    raise SystemExit(125)
fd = os.open('/dev/tty', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY | os.O_CLOEXEC)
saved = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
if saved[3] & termios.ICANON or saved[0] & termios.ICRNL:
    raise SystemExit(91)
quiet = list(saved)
quiet[6] = list(saved[6])
quiet[3] &= ~termios.ECHO
value = bytearray()
try:
    termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH, quiet)
    os.write(fd, b'RAW-PROMPT> ')
    while True:
        char = os.read(fd, 1)
        if not char:
            raise RuntimeError('unexpected terminal EOF')
        if char in (b'\r', b'\n'):
            break
        value.extend(char)
        if len(value) > 4096:
            raise RuntimeError('reference input bound exceeded')
finally:
    termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH, saved)
os.write(fd, b'\n')
os.close(fd)
out = os.open('secret.bin', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
try:
    remaining = memoryview(value)
    while remaining:
        count = os.write(out, remaining)
        if count <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError('short secret write')
        remaining = remaining[count:]
finally:
    os.close(out)
